Full Statement: Leadership Development in Action
Leadership: Individual Skills
Core Standard 1: Students will explore individuals skills related to preparing for leadership roles within their schools, communities, and future careers.
Analyze and apply decision-making skills through classroom, personal, community, and business and industry (work related) experiences
Analyze the characteristics of successful community, business, and industry leaders
Demonstrate oral, interpersonal, written, and electronic communication and presentation skills and understand how to apply those skills
Apply problem-solving, and critical and creative thinking skills to analyze and predict outcomes of related decisions
Practice self-advocacy skills to achieve planned, individual goals
Conduct self in a professional manner in practical career applications, organizational forums, and decision-making bodies
Leadership: Teamwork Skills
Core Standard 2: Students will apply teamwork skills related to preparing for leadership roles within their schools, communities, and future careers.
Communicate, participate, and advocate effectively in pairs, small groups, teams, and large groups in order to reach common goals
Demonstrate techniques for conflict resolution and challenge management
Analyze the complex responsibilities of leader and follower roles and demonstrate the ability to both lead and follow
Demonstrate understanding and acceptance of personal, social and work related responsibilities
Demonstrate a working knowledge of parliamentary procedure
Use knowledge, build interest, guide and influence decisions; organize efforts: and involve members of a group to assure that a pre-planned group activity is completed
Train others to follow established rules and expectations, rationale, and understand consequences
Incorporate and utilize the principles of group dynamics in a variety of settings
Leadership: Community and Career Skills
Core Standard 3: Students will utilize community and career leadership skills in an organizational setting.
Analyze the roles and responsibilities of citizenship
Demonstrate social responsibility in personal, family, community, and business and industry settings
Participate in and evaluate community service and service learning activities
Exhibit the organizational skills necessary to be a successful leader and citizen
Understand and utilize organizational systems to advocate for issues on local, state, and international levels
Describe the importance of and utilize the components and structure of community based organizations
Participate in the development of a program of work or strategic plan to implement the organization’s goals
